title: Peulanggar Perjanjian Nyang Dibuang .
intro: Bak masa awai saboh komunitas nyang mantong barô, saboh sukèe tom tinggai di teumpat tinggai nyang meubenteng, meuikat lé saboh pakto. Watèë pakta njan djikhianat, akibat djih meu-gema rot ôn-ôn Al-Quran. Soe-soe ureuëng-ureuëng nyan, dan peue nyang teujadi ateueh rumoh-rumoh dan lampôh-lampôh boh kayée awaknyan?
clues: Kamoe tinggai di benteng-benteng nyang jibri keu kamoe rasa aman nyang hana beutôi.
Kamoe na kheueh umat Alkitab, teuma kamoe meuiengkeue janji kamoe.
Kamoe meureuncana keu kamoe lawan utosan nyan óh ka lheueh gobnyan teuka ubak kamoe, teuma reuncana kamoe nyan hana meuhase.
Bak-palem kamoë ka djikoh ateuëh peurintah Allah, tanda kuasa Droë neuh.
Kamoe geu-use dari rumoh, hana meugisa le, sibagoe hukoman ateuh peulawanan kamoe.
Al-Quran geuseubôt geutanjoë dalam surah meusapat, dan kisah geutanjoë djeuët keu peuingat keu ureuëng-ureuëng njang meulanggar janji.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Keupung dan peu-use nibak rumoh-rumoh awaknyan .
Teungoh geu ubah jeut keu kera .
trial.answer: Keupung dan peu-use nibak rumoh-rumoh awaknyan .

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
